description: Store-sales forecasting competition with 1800 store-product combinations. Winners used global models (TFT/LightGBM with lags) and rolling-origin validation; per-series ARIMA and random KFold failed.

competition_input.title: Store-Sales Forecasting (1800 series, 5 years)
competition_input.description: Forecast daily sales for 1800 store-product combinations over a 90-day horizon. Training data covers 5 years of history with promotions, holidays, and store metadata.

known_outcome.lesson: Global models with proper rolling-origin CV and lag features were decisive.
